incidents.title: SMS Delivery Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Cell C South Africa
incidents.detail: We have observed a recovery in SMS delivery from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to Cell C network subscribers in South Africa and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 2 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Gateway API (Lookup API) Failure Increase in Canada
incidents.detail: Twilio customers may be experiencing failure responses for Lookup API transactions in Canada. Our team is actively investigating the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

incidents.title: Voice Call Silent and One-Way Audio from Colombia to a Subset of Twilio Phone Numbers
incidents.detail: We have observed a recovery in voice calls from network subscribers in Colombia to a subset of Twilio Phone Numbers and are monitoring service stability. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.
